description: Source code for the PacingSender class implementing pacing logic in QUIC congestion control.

classes.name: PacingSender
classes.description: Implements pacing logic for QUIC congestion control, managing packet send timing and burst tokens.

methods.name: set_sender
methods.description: Sets the underlying send algorithm interface.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events, resets burst tokens on loss.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Updates pacing state after a packet is sent, manages burst tokens and pacing delay.

methods.name: OnApplicationLimited
methods.description: Marks the sender as application-limited, stopping pacing adjustments.

methods.name: SetBurstTokens
methods.description: Sets the initial burst token count.

methods.name: TimeUntilSend
methods.description: Calculates the delay until the next packet can be sent based on pacing logic.

methods.name: PacingRate
methods.description: Returns the current pacing bandwidth estimate.
